notes.title: German translation completed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41607778/fff91d75450e0407a626f7d988f83ea2b2870780.png[/img]

[h3]About this update[/h3]

[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

We are finally releasing the full German Translation for Porcelana. This is a first version of the translation so you might find some few typos here and there but we most of the translation is correct.

If you are a German player and find any mistranslation or typo, feel free to report it on our [url=https://discord.gg/Z3aNf26EaZ]discord server[/url] and we'll fix it in our next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41607778/f46f2b790467a733598bb1f51a34982dd3e9a280.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41607778/68f2c3d12cce4db38cf8b766fd44a4776b694239.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41607778/c917e75673581f066c0a9add6d7c902614874462.png[/img]

[h3]About Turkish translation[/h3]

The Turkish translation will be temporarily removed from the Steam list of supported languages as we don't have a Turkish translator that can finish the rest of the game.

[i]~ Pandita Studio Staff[/i]

notes.title: English-TL patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41607778/d387825fd819a840454ed4a25a1230d81e14584f.png[/img]

[h2]English translation[/h2]

Hello everyone, we have just applied the patch that finally fixes typos and grammar mistakes in the 
English translation.

Thanks to the english speakers community for the help fixing it ːwaifuː

[h2]German and Turkish translation[/h2]

Those translations are taking more than expected so please be patient. Maybe we can have both translations ready at some point of  the next month.

You can [url=https://twitter.com/pandita_studio]follow our social networks[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/Z3aNf26EaZ]Discord server[/url] to stay up to date.

Regards.

~ Pandita Studio Staff
